lint.template: Run Ruff lint and format on the project. Execute `uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run ruff format .`. Report any issues found.

typecheck.template: Run the type checker. Try `uv run ty check .` first, then `uv run mypy .` if ty is not available. Report any type errors.

test.template: Run the full test suite. Execute `uv run pytest tests/ -q`. Report pass/fail counts and any failures. All 100 tests must pass.

preflight.template: Run GPU and environment preflight checks. 1) `nvidia-smi` for GPU health and VRAM. 2) `uv run python -c "import torch; print('CUDA:', torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)); print('VRAM free:', torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0]/1e9, 'GB')"` 3) `uv sync` to verify dependencies. Report GPU status, VRAM budget, and any anomalies.
preflight.description: GPU health and environment check before training

preflight-full.template: Run comprehensive preflight: 1) GPU health via nvidia-smi (temp <50C idle, VRAM free >14GB). 2) Verify uv sync completes. 3) Run PEFT compatibility test: `uv run python scripts/test_peft.py`. 4) Verify Zyphra transformers fork loads: `uv run python -c "from transformers.models.zaya import ZayaForCausalLM; print('ZayaForCausalLM OK')"`. 5) Apply patches and verify: `uv run python -c "from patches.apply_zaya_patches import apply_all_patches; apply_all_patches(); print('Patches OK')"`. Report pass/fail for each gate.
preflight-full.description: Full preflight including PEFT and Zyphra fork verification

smoke-test.template: Run Gate 1 inference quality smoke test. Execute `uv run python scripts/smoke_test_inference.py --base-url http://localhost:8010/v1 --model Zyphra/ZAYA1-8B --prompts prompts/smoke_test.jsonl`. Verify: coherent output, <think>/<|im_end|> tokens handled, tool-call XML parses correctly on >=4/5 prompts. Report pass/fail for each prompt.
smoke-test.description: Gate 1: Verify vLLM FP8 inference quality with 5 prompts

test-max-len.template: Run Gate 2 max-model-len regression test. Test if --max-model-len 4096 works on the FP8 server. If the server is running with 2048, kill it and restart with 4096. Execute `python scripts/serve_zaya1.py --port 8010 --quantization fp8 --max-model-len 4096 --start`. If OOM or corrupt output, document root cause and keep 2048. Report result and final value.

probe-ct.template: Run Gate 3 CCA compatibility probe. Execute `uv run python scripts/probe_ct_quantization.py`. This tests compressed_tensors NVFP4A16 scheme on the first 2 layers of ZAYA1-8B. Verify: CCA attention layers are correctly targeted or explicitly skipped to BF16, FusedMoE layers are in the targeted set, no crash during quantization prep. Report pass/fail and any incompatibility findings.
probe-ct.description: Gate 3: Probe compressed_tensors on Zaya CCA architecture

build-calibration.template: Run Gate 4 calibration dataset build. Execute `uv run python scripts/build_calibration_data.py`. Builds 512 samples from MATH-500, HumanEval, ShareGPT, AIME. Tokenize to 1024 tokens each. Verify dataset saved to data/calibration/. Report sample count, token distribution, and source breakdown.
build-calibration.description: Gate 4: Build NVFP4 calibration dataset (512 samples)

validate-gates.template: Run all 4 validation gates sequentially. Report pass/fail for each: 1) Gate 1 smoke-test: inference quality on 5 prompts. 2) Gate 2 test-max-len: 4096 vs 2048 regression. 3) Gate 3 probe-ct: CCA compressed_tensors compatibility. 4) Gate 4 build-calibration: 512-sample dataset. If all pass, Stage 1 quantization is cleared to proceed. If any fail, fix before committing compute.
validate-gates.description: Run all 4 validation gates before Stage 1 quantization

stage1-quantize.template: Run Stage 1 NVFP4 compressed-tensors quantization. WARNING: 6-9 hours GPU compute. Execute `uv run python scripts/quantize_zaya_ct_nvfp4.py`. Prerequisites: all 4 validation gates must pass first. Expected output: ./zaya1-8b-nvfp4-ct/ with safetensors + config.json containing quantization_config. Monitor VRAM: expect ~6.2 GB peak. Report quantization time, model size, compression ratio, and any errors.
stage1-quantize.description: Stage 1: Quantize ZAYA1-8B to NVFP4 compressed-tensors (6-9 hrs)

stage1-benchmark.template: Benchmark the Stage 1 NVFP4 CT model against BF16 baselines. Execute lm_eval against AIME'26, GPQA-Diamond, MMLU-Pro, LiveCodeBench. Degradation thresholds: AIME < -3.0, GPQA < -2.0, MMLU-Pro < -1.5, LiveCodeBench < -2.0. If any benchmark fails, investigate CCA fallback tensors. Report scores and pass/fail vs each threshold.
stage1-benchmark.description: Benchmark Stage 1 NVFP4 model vs BF16 baseline

stage1-publish.template: Publish Stage 1 NVFP4 model to HuggingFace. Execute `uv run python scripts/push_to_hub.py`. Uploads ./zaya1-8b-nvfp4-ct/ to t-timms/ZAYA1-8B-NVFP4-CT. Verify model card includes: hardware (RTX 5070 Ti), quantization method (compressed-tensors NVFP4A16), calibration (512 mixed reasoning), benchmark table, serving command. Report HF URL after upload.
stage1-publish.description: Publish Stage 1 NVFP4 model to HuggingFace

train-dry-run.template: Run a training dry-run to validate VRAM budget. Execute `uv run python scripts/train.py --config configs/lora_tool_call.yaml --dry-run`. Verify: VRAM stays under 14GB, forward+backward pass succeeds, no OOM. Report peak VRAM and whether the config is safe for full training.

nvfp4-weights.template: Verify NVFP4 GGUF weight integrity. Execute `uv run python scripts/verify_nvfp4_weights.py`. Checks: mean error vs original BF16 model (expected ~0.026), 1641 NVFP4 + 842 F16 tensors, 4.52 bpw effective, name_map.json has 2483 entries with 0 failures. Report pass/fail for each check.

audit-secrets.template: Audit the repository for secrets and hardcoded credentials. Search for: API keys, .env files, BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, tokens with prefixes nvapi-, sk-ant-, sk-, AIza, ghp_, AKIA, hf_. Check .gitignore excludes sensitive files. Report any findings with file paths.

env-check.template: Verify the conda environment for this project. Execute `conda activate mlenv && python -c "import torch,transformers,trl,unsloth,peft,bitsandbytes; print('torch', torch.__version__); print('CUDA:', torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)); print('VRAM free:', torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0]/1e9, 'GB')"`. Report version mismatches vs expected values in AGENTS.md.
